title: Multi-Currency Row Check
description: Book five shipments and invoice each in a different one of SwiftCargo's five supported currencies, then prove the Billing table reads correctly across the whole row — no currency's formatting quietly breaks the others.
successCondition: Booking five shipments and generating one invoice per shipment across all five BILLING_CURRENCIES values (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, INR) results in five rows on /billing, each showing its Shipment Price column in the shipment's original USD pricing and its Invoice column showing the converted amount with the correct currency symbol/code and correct decimal handling (JPY with zero decimal places, the other four with two) — every row checked individually against its own invoice's raw amountCents and currency from the API.
hints: The "Shipment Price" column always shows the original USD price the booking was made at — only the "Invoice" column reflects the chosen billing currency and its converted amount.
Fixed exchange rate constants live in apps/api/src/modules/billing/currency.ts if you want to precompute expected converted values rather than trusting the API blindly.
